messages:
Maya (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about GTM priorities and partner pipeline. Need explicit owner for partner onboarding SLA, revenue credit rules, and a partner-focused pipeline view.

Ravi (Sales): Answering briefly: Q next quarter goal ~60% partner-led for enterprise. Crediting baseline referral = 30% Y1 unless co-sell. Legal/RevOps to finalize clause.

Ben (GTM): Published partner pipeline dashboard (internal): https://redwood.app/dashboards/partner-pipeline (beta). Use filters partner_tag, origin, ARR. I'll add a saved "Leadership" view and ping when done.

Elena (Partnerships): Enablement update: onboarding kit goes live next Tue 5 items: playbook, pricing FAQ, joint demo checklist, tech checklist, partner contract summary. Plan 2 pilot partners.

Priya (Rev Ops): Drafting referral addendum template. Sample: `Partner referral fee = 30% of first-year invoiced revenue, payable net 30 after collection, subject to cancellations.` Will circulate Wed.

Allison (CEO): Strategic: focus partners that open regulated verticals (healthcare, finance). We'll assign AM headcount to top 5 partners. Can onboarding shrink from 8w to ~4w? Elena?

Elena (Partnerships): Possible if Sales + Product commit to a POA. Proposed timeline: 3w enablement + 1w tech onboarding for MVP.

Maya (Product): Product question: will we add partner-specific routing/policy metadata (eg route-by-partner-SLA)? Need scope.

Ravi (Sales): High priority for sales motions. Ben, confirm MVP scope/ETA?

Ben (GTM): MVP: partner tags, routing config, SLA metadata, saved pipeline view. ETA internal beta by end Q3; canary with Partner A.

Maya (Product): Who owns rollout comms and playbook updates?

Priya (Rev Ops): I'll own comms and playbook updates; need final assets from Partnerships and docs from Product.

Elena (Partnerships): Posting slides + onboarding checklist in #partners in ~30m. @Priya assign follow-ups there.

deploy-bot: Slides uploaded: https://redwood.app/files/allhands-q3-partners.pdf

Ravi (Sales): One last nuance: crediting a partner that introduced a lead but isn't on the final contract. Current rule unclear.

Allison (CEO): Decision: institute an "influence" credit. If partner created the first qualified touch, assign 20% influence credit unless documented co-sell. Formalize in partner policy doc.

Maya (Product): Recap action items: Ben to share leadership view (soon), Elena to post enablement assets (~30m), Priya to circulate referral addendum draft by Wed, Allison to approve influence policy. Leaving thread open for quick clarifications. :thumbsup:
